title: Kaura Mal’s Battle with Shah Nawaz

blocks.text: This fragment concentrates the clash between Kaura Mal and Shah Nawaz into a sharp battlefield encounter. As both sides commit themselves, the Singhs around Kaura Mal encourage steadfastness and turn the struggle from anxiety into direct offensive action.

The decisive stroke is delivered against Shah Nawaz himself. In the fierce close of the encounter, the Singhs beheaded Shah Nawaz and turned his fall into the clearest sign that his power had finally been broken.

The page ends by converting battlefield success into public honor. Kaura Mal receives recognition for the feat, and the episode closes with the sense that courage aligned with the Panth has defeated both cruelty and arrogance.
